references.text: Moses counts the Levites according to the Lord's command, as he was instructed in verse 16.
Moses counts the firstborn of Israel according to the Lord's command, continuing the obedience described in verse 16.
Moses acts on the Lord's word, following the same pattern of obedience seen in verse 16.
The Levites are numbered by the Lord's command through Moses, consistent with the pattern from 3:16.
The Lord speaks to Moses, who then acts on the Lord's command - the same pattern of authority.
Moses does everything just as the Lord had commanded him, showing the same obedience described in Num 3:16.
Moses, the servant of the Lord, acted according to the Lord's word throughout his life.
